answer: Run a first-contact challenge at registration. When a new account joins, 5 veteran accounts each ask it one fresh question, and it must answer all of them live within 60 seconds, not from a script. A veteran who passes a puppet earns nothing, but one who flags a verified sybil earns 10 tokens. A farm of 1,000 puppets must pass 5,000 live exchanges. Like a crystal under light, a fake shows its flaws only when probed. Puppets that wander off-script get flagged at dawn.
